profile.concavityEvidence: coarse visual estimate using available oblique product references
profile.profileEvidence: Individual local front and supporting profile/oblique source photos; visual proportions, not measured dimensions.
profile.profileObservation: Ten broad Y roots bend deeply toward the hub; narrow outer branches carry restrained machined edge highlights.
profile.finishObservation: Visual preview finish selected from the reviewed photograph; exposure/shadows are not used as a literal metal colour. Production finish is configurable.

notes: Two mounting bores on the native CF7M front reference are opaque white while the other three have transparent centers. Both white circular boundaries were individually measured; the lower reflected tabs were excluded from its circular fit. Supporting oblique photos show the same five true bores. All original source contours remain alpha-traced.
